events.title: Demo Update 0.1.5d & Content Creator Outreach
events.summary: Hi all!In preparation of next week's Steam Next Fest, which Red Echoes: Berlin will be a part of, I've updated the demo again.Most changes are bugfixes/UI improvements, with the only major change being a rework of how the State chooses which districts to target at the end of every turn. It now should take into account the state of the map better.I've also been very busy contacting content creators asking them if they are interested in playing the game on their channels. You can find the full changelog below.Also, as of yesterday evening, Red Echoes: Berlin is part of the party-based RPG fest on Steam! events.title: Demo out now!
events.summary: Hi all! Very excited to announce that the Red Echoes: Berlin demo is now available for download on Steam!The demo contains the first half of Chapter 1. While I've tried to stamp out as many bugs and typos as possible, there's likely to still be some remaining - these will be patched out over time.To make my life easier, please report any issues you're having on the Community Hub or in the Discord!https://discord.com/invite/fPpupqEu8rI'd love to hear all of your thoughts, feedback, and opinions!
